basic_profile.bio: I'm a 17-year-old high school student from Sheffield, UK. I have a deep love for jazz music, especially jazz fusion, and spend a lot of my free time exploring new music and artists. I dislike overly crowded places and prefer intimate gatherings with close friends. I usually browse Reddit in the evenings after finishing my homework or during weekends. Currently, I don't have a part-time job, but I'm considering looking for one soon. I'm single, and I enjoy connecting with people online who share similar interests.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: My knowledge of jazz comes from my dad, who is a jazz musician. I grew up listening to his records and attending his gigs. I also play the guitar and have been learning more about music theory through online courses and tutorials.
